title: Enhancing Automated Unit Test Generation for NLP Libraries Using Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.14784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated unit test generation tools like EvoSuite perform well on general-purpose software but often struggle with domain-specific software such as Natural Language Processing (NLP) libraries, where inputs must follow semantic, syntactic, and structural constraints. Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate domain-relevant test code, but tests produced by LLMs alone often fail to compile or achieve sufficient coverage. We propose LLMSuite, a hybrid test generation framework that integrates self-refinement prompting with class-level LLM reasoning into the search-based testing process. In this mechanism, the LLM iteratively improves its test snippets based on feedback from previous generations. This enables the model to produce increasingly precise, domain-consistent code fragments that steer the evolutionary search toward exercising complex and otherwise hard-to-reach behaviors. translated_title: 使用大型语言模型增强NLP库的自动化单元测试生成
translated_abstract: 像EvoSuite这样的自动化单元测试生成工具在通用软件上表现良好，但在处理自然语言处理（NLP）库等特定领域软件时常常遇到困难，因为这类软件的输入必须遵循语义、句法和结构约束。大型语言模型（LLM）可以生成与领域相关的测试代码，但仅由LLM生成的测试往往无法编译或无法达到足够的覆盖率。我们提出了LLMSuite，这是一个混合测试生成框架，它将自我改进提示机制与类级别的LLM推理集成到基于搜索的测试过程中。在这种机制中，LLM根据先前生成结果的反馈迭代地改进其测试片段。这使模型能够产生越来越精确、符合领域规范的代码片段，引导进化搜索去执行复杂且原本难以触及的软件行为。当多代迭代中没有任何优化目标得到改善时……
tldr: 本文提出LLMSuite混合测试生成框架，将自我改进提示与类级别LLM推理集成到基于搜索的测试过程中，通过LLM根据反馈迭代优化测试片段，引导进化搜索覆盖NLP库中难以触及的复杂行为，从而提升特定领域软件的自动化单元测试生成效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLMSuite, a hybrid test generation framework that integrates self-refinement prompting and class-level LLM reasoning into search-based testing, enabling LLMs to iteratively refine test snippets based on feedback to steer evolutionary search toward complex, hard-to-reach behaviors in NLP libraries.
